Title: How can I create this SQL?
Description: Hello. 
## What you are doing?

``` js
Room.belongsTo(Hotel, {foreignKey: 'hotelId'});

Room.findAndCountAll({
  where: {
    sellPrice: {lte: 10000}
  },
  include: [{
    model: Hotel,
    required: false,
    where: {
      region: 'Tokyo'
```
